correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives P'=3delta(A-B). Under 0<delta<3/10, A'<0 and B'>0 uniformly; midpoint derivative is positive and endpoint derivative crosses zero uniquely as L increases. This proves all global maximizers and the threshold. Logarithmic expansion at the interior optimum gives delta/(6 kappa^2 L)+o(1/L). All speed factors remain positive, including zero minimum-gap limit. The standalone rational/numeric checker passed 19,724 supplementary assertions, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A fixed-distance row with a movable middle turbine and constrained minimum spacing is a natural small analytic test for wake-based layout optimization. A unique cutoff and exact asymmetry sign distinguish constraint activation from an interior optimum and can test the behavior of larger numerical solvers. The O(L^-1) bias is a meaningful asymptotic classification. Neither practical power gain nor generality to other wake laws is asserted.
